text: 7. SCOMET GAEIS issued for export / re-export of SCOMET items Authorisation under the above Categories / Sub Categories shall be valid Issued under for Three years from the date of issue of GAEIS subject to GAEIS Policy subsequent post reporting(s) on quarterly basis to be reported within 30 days from the last quarter
